compatibility: sanitize remains an opaque envelope admission API; it supplies no verified decoder evidence

audio: RIFF/WAVE integer PCM, 8/16/24/32 bits, one fmt and one data chunk

decoder: PNG structure, CRC and bounded zlib scanlines validate before Pillow verification and full bounded RGB/RGBA decode; JPEG/WebP require Pillow header admission then full bounded decode. WAVE uses strict bounded RIFF structure and stdlib wave sample verification. Pillow absence or permissive truncated-image configuration fails verified image intake.
receipt: Immutable deterministic identity binds source bytes, actual container format, measured geometry/audio parameters, decoder version, selected resource ceilings and exact decoded output digest; receipt is evidence of decoding, not semantic/OCR/ASR correctness.
metadata: Caller dimensions, duration and sample rate must agree with measurements; measured fields replace accepted scalar metadata. No metadata or derived media gains instruction authority.
atomicity: Parsing and verification finish before asset publication. Corruption, unsupported format, MIME disagreement, metadata conflict, budget exhaustion or identity reuse conflict publishes no asset.
revalidation: verify_verified_asset re-verifies actual payload and immutable receipt/asset fields; constructing or mutating a receipt does not confer decoder authority.
failure_contract: MultimodalSanitizationError at intake; MediaValidationError inside decoder adapter
rollback: Withdraw verified-intake adapter without deleting issued source/projection lineage; opaque compatibility assets remain explicitly outside decoder evidence.
